title: Joshua 15: The Lot of the Tribe of Judah
body:
Read the chapter → [Joshua 15](/bible/joshua/15)

**[Joshua 15:1-4](/bible/joshua/15#v1)**

> <sup>[1](/bible/joshua/15#v1)</sup> This then was the lot of the tribe of the children of Judah by their families; even to the border of Edom the wilderness of Zin southward was the uttermost part of the south coast.
>
> <sup>[2](/bible/joshua/15#v2)</sup> And their south border was from the shore of the salt sea, from the bay that looketh southward:
>
> <sup>[3](/bible/joshua/15#v3)</sup> And it went out to the south side to Maaleh–acrabbim, and passed along to Zin, and ascended up on the south side unto Kadesh–barnea, and passed along to Hezron, and went up to Adar, and fetched a compass to Karkaa:
>
> <sup>[4](/bible/joshua/15#v4)</sup> From thence it passed toward Azmon, and went out unto the river of Egypt; and the goings out of that coast were at the sea: this shall be your south coast.

- This is the lot of the tribe of the children of Judah by their families, even to the border of Edom: the south border ran from the shore of the salt sea, up the south side of Kadeshbarnea, and out unto the river of Egypt, with the goings out of that coast at the sea.
- We are not locating every one of these places as we read, but as you go back and listen, look these places up in your Bible atlas so you can see the actual areas being read about in the region.

**[Joshua 15:5-12](/bible/joshua/15#v5)**

> <sup>[5](/bible/joshua/15#v5)</sup> And the east border was the salt sea, even unto the end of Jordan. And their border in the north quarter was from the bay of the sea at the uttermost part of Jordan:
>
> <sup>[6](/bible/joshua/15#v6)</sup> And the border went up to Beth–hogla, and passed along by the north of Beth–arabah; and the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben:
>
> <sup>[7](/bible/joshua/15#v7)</sup> And the border went up toward Debir from the valley of Achor, and so northward, looking toward Gilgal, that is before the going up to Adummim, which is on the south side of the river: and the border passed toward the waters of En–shemesh, and the goings out thereof were at En–rogel:
>
> <sup>[8](/bible/joshua/15#v8)</sup> And the border went up by the valley of the son of Hinnom unto the south side of the Jebusite; the same is Jerusalem: and the border went up to the top of the mountain that lieth before the valley of Hinnom westward, which is at the end of the valley of the giants northward:
>
> <sup>[9](/bible/joshua/15#v9)</sup> And the border was drawn from the top of the hill unto the fountain of the water of Nephtoah, and went out to the cities of mount Ephron; and the border was drawn to Baalah, which is Kirjath–jearim:
>
> <sup>[10](/bible/joshua/15#v10)</sup> And the border compassed from Baalah westward unto mount Seir, and passed along unto the side of mount Jearim, which is Chesalon, on the north side, and went down to Beth–shemesh, and passed on to Timnah:
>
> <sup>[11](/bible/joshua/15#v11)</sup> And the border went out unto the side of Ekron northward: and the border was drawn to Shicron, and passed along to mount Baalah, and went out unto Jabneel; and the goings out of the border were at the sea.
>
> <sup>[12](/bible/joshua/15#v12)</sup> And the west border was to the great sea, and the coast thereof. This is the coast of the children of Judah round about according to their families.

- The east border was the salt sea unto the end of Jordan; the north border went up from the bay of the sea, by Bethhogla and the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben, and up by the valley of the son of Hinnom unto the south side of the Jebusite: the same is Jerusalem.
- The border went to the top of the mountain before the valley of Hinnom westward, at the end of the valley of the giants northward, then out by Kirjathjearim, Bethshemesh, and Ekron, and the west border was to the great sea. This is the coast of the children of Judah round about according to their families.

**[Joshua 15:13-19](/bible/joshua/15#v13)**

> <sup>[13](/bible/joshua/15#v13)</sup> And unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh he gave a part among the children of Judah, according to the commandment of the Lord to Joshua, even the city of Arba the father of Anak, which city is Hebron.
>
> <sup>[14](/bible/joshua/15#v14)</sup> And Caleb drove thence the three sons of Anak, Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.
>
> <sup>[15](/bible/joshua/15#v15)</sup> And he went up thence to the inhabitants of Debir: and the name of Debir before was Kirjath–sepher.
>
> <sup>[16](/bible/joshua/15#v16)</sup> And Caleb said, He that smiteth Kirjath–sepher, and taketh it, to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife.
>
> <sup>[17](/bible/joshua/15#v17)</sup> And Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife.
>
> <sup>[18](/bible/joshua/15#v18)</sup> And it came to pass, as she came unto him, that she moved him to ask of her father a field: and she lighted off her ass; and Caleb said unto her, What wouldest thou?
>
> <sup>[19](/bible/joshua/15#v19)</sup> Who answered, Give me a blessing; for thou hast given me a south land; give me also springs of water. And he gave her the upper springs, and the nether springs.

- Unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh was given a part among the children of Judah according to the commandment of the Lord to Joshua: the city of Arba the father of Anak, which city is Hebron. And Caleb drove thence the three sons of Anak: Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.
- He went up thence to the inhabitants of Debir, whose name before was Kirjathsepher, and said, he that smiteth Kirjathsepher and taketh it, to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife. Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it, and got Achsah to wife.
- Achsah moved him to ask of her father a field, and said, give me a blessing, for thou hast given me a south land; give me also springs of water. And Caleb gave her the upper springs and the nether springs.

**[Joshua 15:20](/bible/joshua/15#v20)**

> <sup>[20](/bible/joshua/15#v20)</sup> This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families.

- This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families, and the chapter counts out their cities district by district through verse 62: the uttermost cities toward the coast of Edom southward, twenty and nine cities with their villages; the cities in the valley in their groups of fourteen, sixteen, and nine; Ekron, Ashdod, and Gaza with their towns and villages unto the river of Egypt and the great sea; the cities in the mountains in their groups of eleven, nine, ten, six, and two; and six cities in the wilderness, all with their villages.

**[Joshua 15:63](/bible/joshua/15#v63)**

> <sup>[63](/bible/joshua/15#v63)</sup> As for the Jebusites the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the children of Judah could not drive them out: but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Judah at Jerusalem unto this day.

- As for the Jebusites, the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the children of Judah could not drive them out, but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Judah at Jerusalem unto this day.
- Later on David conquered this place. The Jebusites thought David could not come in, that he was not getting past those walls, saying except thou take away the blind and the lame thou shalt not come in hither; nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion, the same is the city of David, and dwelt in the fort and built round about.
- The people that were left of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites, whom Israel was not able utterly to destroy, upon those did Solomon levy a tribute of bondservice unto this day. They were forced to become our bondservants.

  Precepts:
  - **[2 Samuel 5:6-9](/bible/2-samuel/5#v6)**
    > <sup>[6](/bible/2-samuel/5#v6)</sup> And the king and his men went to Jerusalem unto the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land: which spake unto David, saying, Except thou take away the blind and the lame, thou shalt not come in hither: thinking, David cannot come in hither.
    >
    > <sup>[7](/bible/2-samuel/5#v7)</sup> Nevertheless David took the strong hold of Zion: the same is the city of David.
    >
    > <sup>[8](/bible/2-samuel/5#v8)</sup> And David said on that day, Whosoever getteth up to the gutter, and smiteth the Jebusites, and the lame and the blind, that are hated of David’s soul, he shall be chief and captain. Wherefore they said, The blind and the lame shall not come into the house.
    >
    > <sup>[9](/bible/2-samuel/5#v9)</sup> So David dwelt in the fort, and called it the city of David. And David built round about from Millo and inward.

    The Jebusites said David could not come in hither, but David took the stronghold of Zion, the same is the city of David.
  - **[1 Kings 9:20-21](/bible/1-kings/9#v20)**
    > <sup>[20](/bible/1-kings/9#v20)</sup> And all the people that were left of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites, which were not of the children of Israel,
    >
    > <sup>[21](/bible/1-kings/9#v21)</sup> Their children that were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel also were not able utterly to destroy, upon those did Solomon levy a tribute of bondservice unto this day.

    Upon the people left of those nations did Solomon levy a tribute of bondservice unto this day.
